title: Drive-through facilities
previewText: In C1 through C7 Districts, accessory drive-through facilities for any use listed in Use Group VI, as set forth in Section 32-16 (Use Group VI – Retail and Services), may be permitted by special permit of the Board of Standards and Appeals, in accordance with Section 73-311 (Drive-through facilities).
